adopt: Run one GobboNet campaign where the harness, not the human, keeps the notes.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Long roleplay campaigns decay: the model loops, forgets what each character knows, and the only fix is a human curating notes by hand. Per-NPC knowledge scoping is exactly the memory-boundary problem agents already have.

Install
pip install awdk
synopsis: GobboNet campaigns with a real agent brain
